scope: Local UR12e URSim software integration; not physical robot acceptance

image.selection_reason: Official start_ursim script identifies ur12e as e-series with minimum 5.22.0. Exact equivalence to the supplied physical-controller component version screenshot is unverified.

external_control.digest_provenance: Computed from the official GitHub release asset on 2026-10-27, independently matched after the local verified-TLS download. The historical GitHub asset has no published digest field.

program_template.note: Only the External Control program-node structure is reused. The bundled UR5 kinematics and robot serial metadata are removed. UR12's generated installation is configured and saved in its actual PolyScope GUI.
